entities.summary: Saad Hanna Sirop is an Iraqi hierarch of the Chaldean Catholic Church who has served as titular bishop of Hirta and auxiliary bishop of the Patriarchate of Babylon of the Chaldeans. He was appointed apostolic visitor for Chaldean faithful residing in Europe in 2016 and later served as apostolic administrator of the Chaldean Catholic Eparchy of Saint Peter the Apostle of San Diego since 2026.
